messages:
sam: Heads-up: ZenithBio execs escalated the POC. CTO wants a single PDF with outstanding blockers + owners + ETA by tomorrow morning. Main asks: SSO test tenant, filled security questionnaire, BYO-KMS integration notes, and pilot pricing.

emily: copying. I can own the PDF but need clear owners for each blocker. who will take KMS and sec Q?

raj: I'll take KMS and cryptography section. quick clarification: do they require HSM-attested keys or is key-wrapping acceptable for pilot?

sam: CTO said attestation is "preferred" but they'll accept key-wrap for short pilot. emphasize the attestation lead time.

toni: I'll handle the questionnaire and SOC2 mapping. please share the link to the version they submitted.

emily: it's in the deal binder: https://redwood.internal/deals/zenithbio/sec-q-2026-v2.docx. Toni can you draft answers focusing on: data flows, retention, incident response, and encryption?

toni: yes. I'll stub answers and flag anything that needs engineering sign-off. ETA tonight 19:30 PT.

raj: For BYO-KMS I'll attach a short integration diagram and two options: (1) Key-wrap (fast, 48-72h) or (2) HSM attestation (3-5 weeks paperwork). Will include sample PKCS#11 call sequence.

infra-bot: Ticket created RB-2210: Okta test tenant request for ZenithBio. Assigned: infra-oncall. ETA 20h. Please add admin contact to ticket.

emily: Pilot pricing note: can someone draft a conservative baseline? assume 100 concurrent sessions, avg 350 tokens, spikes 400 req/min. need baseline reserved + overage rate.

sam: Ops: if we need Dedicated GPUs we need 48h to provision; note that in the PDF. Also flag EU-data residency if they ask.

toni: I'll add a short playbook for SSO setup and paste a SCIM snippet: ```
scim:
  group_map:
    eng: RDW_ENG
    ops: RDW_OPS
```

raj: Adding KMS caveat: if they insist on FIPS 140-2 L3 attestation, vendor paperwork 3+ weeks. Include fallback of proxy-key model for pilot.

emily: Great. Draft PDF outline: 1) one-slide blockers + owners 2) timeline options (fast path vs attestation path) 3) pricing ballpark 4) next steps.

legal: FYI: if they request packet capture for inspection during pilot, we need a signed addendum. call that out.

sam: Action items:
- toni: questionnaire draft (due tonight 19:30 PT)
- raj: KMS diagram + attestation note (due Tue 09:00 PT)
- emily: assemble PDF (first pass Tue 07:00 PT)
- infra-oncall: SSO ticket RB-2210 (ETA 20h)
- sam: confirm Dedicated provisioning lead time in the PDF

emily: I'll circulate the PDF for sign-off by 07:30 PT. Keep comments short. If anything blocks, escalate here and @sam.

toni: uploading first pass to the binder now, will paste link when available.

raj: linking KMS diagram in the ticket when uploaded.

sam: Thanks all. Tight turnaround but doable. :thumbsup:
